coverage: 2000-present: current-Governor index from January 2019 (many migrated document links are unavailable and are disclosed record-by-record), plus 11 weather declarations added by hand by Governors Richardson (2006-2010) and Martinez (2011-2014), from executive orders reprinted in the press, the Martinez-era executive order list as captured by the End of Term web archive in 2016, and dated news coverage. Executive Order 2012-018, a statewide emergency for flood potential after wildfires signed four days before the June 2012 flooding, is counted for DR-4079 because it names the flood hazard and was in force when the flooding began. No state declaration was found for DR-1329 and EM-3154 (Cerro Grande Fire, May 2000) or DR-1514 (April 2004 storms and flooding); plus 1 weather declaration from FMCSA's archive of state emergency declarations (2017-present)
